info.title: MICROSERVICE-development-fulfillment-dotnet-api-Get Api Payment By Payment Id-v1-spec
info.description: The Payment Retrieval API allows users to access detailed information about a specific payment using its unique payment ID. This endpoint is essential for businesses needing to track payment statuses, verify transactions, or fetch payment details for customer inquiries. Developers building applications that require interaction with payment data, such as e-commerce platforms or financial dashboards, can utilize this API. It streamlines the process of obtaining payment-related information, enhancing operational efficiency and customer service.

get.summary: Retrieve a specific payment by its ID.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the details of a specific payment using its unique identifier. It returns all relevant information associated with the payment, enabling developers to verify the payment status and details.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning payment details.

bearerAuth.description: This security scheme uses the Bearer authentication method, which involves sending a token in the Authorization header of the HTTP request. Typically, the token is a JSON Web Token (JWT) that contains claims about the user or application making the request.
